description: Super is a gaming platform that blends casual gameplay with real-money rewards, creating a more engaging and rewarding entertainment experience. Focused on “real money entertainment,” Super aims to make gaming more interactive by combining fun with the opportunity to earn.

Creed is building the first AI rooted in Christian values, designed to safeguard truth, center Scripture, and support the spiritual lives of believers. Its debut product is a digital companion that helps churches and individuals engage more deeply with faith through thoughtful, trustworthy AI guidance.

Arro helps people take control of their financial future with a credit card and app built to make credit building simple, accessible, and stress-free. With personalized guidance, rewards, and smart tools, Arro empowers users to grow their credit while building healthier money habits.

All 3D is transforming home goods with virtual-first design. Our platform lets manufacturers and retailers design, customize, showcase, and sell products virtually — enabling a sustainable shift from physical-first to digital-first production.
DAASH unlocks actionable data that empowers brands to make informed strategic decisions and enhance performance.
EQL Games drives innovation in the lottery industry. With a modern tech stack, EQL delivers disruptive, first-to-market products as both an original game studio and a third-party content aggregator.

PackageX is an all-in-one logistics platform, modernizing inventory, fulfillment, shipping, and receiving.
CAMP creates enriching experiences for families. Blending play, media, and merchandise, CAMP inspires and engages kids and grown-ups alike.
AllCity is a game-changing network for local sports.
Switchyards is the world’s first neighborhood work club, creating places to do our best thinking and most productive work.

Thrive Fantasy offers a streamlined DFS experience for casual fans. By focusing on top-tier athletes and simplifying the drafting process, Thrive gives sports and esports fans the chance to compete and win at a high level.

Beryllium expands trading beyond traditional markets. Starting with fantasy sports, the scalable Beryllium platform delivers a digital-native, experience-driven way to trade across industries — with the goal of making trading ubiquitous.

We’re building the future of content for talented creators. Our collab house is for creators with genuine skill — natural or hard-earned — and not for those seeking fame for its own sake.
Rei do Pitaco is Brazil’s first trusted Daily Fantasy Sports app. The platform lets fans compete in single-round fantasy contests for all major football leagues, making sports more fun and engaging.
Roofr is the complete sales platform for roofers. From accurate measurement reports to project-winning proposals, Roofr helps roofing professionals close more deals and build trust.

OneRail powers final-mile, multi-modal delivery at scale. Its all-in-one shipping orchestration platform connects leading brands in retail, healthcare, manufacturing, grocery, and logistics to a national network of 4.5 million drivers.

We build software for the next chapter of the Internet economy. Our tools empower online businesses to thrive around their communities — from journalists and readers to yogis and fans — fostering a new wave of entrepreneurship built on trust.

Ocrolus automates document-driven workflows for financial services. With human-in-the-loop infrastructure, Ocrolus delivers trusted data and precision automation to help companies make high-quality decisions efficiently.
Atrium delivers data-driven team management for modern sales. Its analytics platform automates performance insights, helping sales leaders excel without the manual analysis.

Blueboard delivers experiential rewards for the modern workplace. With just a click, companies can recognize employees with curated experiences and activities through Blueboard’s easy-to-use platform.
Classy modernizes nonprofit fundraising. As a social enterprise, Classy builds world-class online giving tools that help nonprofits accelerate social impact worldwide.

Confident Cannabis brings transparency to the cannabis supply chain. Producers, processors, wholesalers, and retailers showcase verified products with licensed lab results, enabling all stakeholders — and consumers — to know what’s made, who makes it, and what’s in it.

Fama automates compliant online talent screening. Our software detects harmful online behaviors at the point of hire, helping organizations protect their brand, reduce workplace toxicity, and build healthier cultures.

Grassroots Unwired uses mobile-first tech for social impact. We partner with nonprofits dedicated to environmental protection, equity, and community improvement — customizing technology to advance their missions.

Improvado streamlines marketing data management. By automating data aggregation and reporting, Improvado frees marketers from manual processes and developers from maintaining integrations — delivering insights in minutes.

Namely is the HR, payroll, and benefits platform employees love. Built to fit your company culture, Namely centralizes HR data and offers personalized service — helping innovative companies manage people better and faster.

Paper delivers equitable academic support for every student. As the first comprehensive Educational Support System, Paper offers live help and writing feedback for students alongside real-time tools for teachers to intervene and guide learning.
SpaceIQ delivers powerful, easy-to-use facility management software. Our CAFM and IWMS solutions help companies of all sizes manage facilities efficiently and effectively.
Ureeka is a platform for Next Wave entrepreneurs. Built with underserved founders in mind, Ureeka connects entrepreneurs to the people, programs, and resources they need to grow.
Manufactured builds digital manufacturing supply chains. We help brands, agencies, and enterprises source products efficiently in the era of connected commerce.

The industry's first talent operations platform for interview scheduling and interviewer training. GoodTime enables companies to schedule candidate interviews up to 10x faster by fully automating the scheduling process. With GoodTime, recruiting teams spend time recruiting rather than scheduling.

Entera is transforming how people buy homes. Built for buyers, Entera’s real estate platform powers billions in transactions for institutional investors and now offers all homebuyers data-driven tools to control their journey.

Braze powers personalized, cross-channel customer engagement. Used by leading brands, Braze helps businesses deliver timely, targeted messages across channels — strengthening customer relationships and optimizing campaign performance.

BentoBox builds restaurant websites that drive business. With mobile-friendly design, built-in hospitality tools, hosting, and support, BentoBox helps restaurants attract and convert customers with ease.
Barn2Door is a vertical SaaS solution for farmers to manage direct sales, customers, inventory, and fulfillment seamlessly across multiple channels.

Beyond Pricing is the leading dynamic pricing platform for vacation rentals. Used by $2B+ in listings across 7,000+ cities, Beyond Pricing helps hosts optimize revenue with the world’s first revenue management software built for short-term rentals.

Modal powers seamless digital auto commerce. Built for the world’s top auto brands and retailers, Modal simplifies complex car transactions into a fully digital experience that integrates effortlessly into any website or showroom.

NaviStone bridges digital intent with direct mail. By adding a simple line of code to your site, NaviStone helps marketers identify high-intent web visitors and reach them with targeted, measurable direct marketing campaigns.

Octane AI powers personalized commerce for 1,000+ brands. With tools for quizzes, Messenger and SMS automation, and opt-ins, Octane AI helps merchants personalize the customer journey to drive growth, conversions, and retention.

Plink is the first personalized commerce platform for small businesses. By bringing transaction intelligence to independent retailers nationwide, Plink empowers local businesses to compete and grow with data-driven tools.

OpenLattice empowers governments with data-driven decision-making. By integrating structured data across agencies, OpenLattice helps state and local governments address challenges like mass incarceration and the opioid crisis through actionable, workflow-based interventions.

SkyWatch simplifies access to Earth observation data. By providing digital infrastructure for data distribution, SkyWatch removes complexity so users can focus on insights, not sourcing or processing.

Windfall helps organizations engage affluent consumers through data. With the industry’s most accurate dataset, Windfall enables data-driven teams to identify, understand, and connect with high-value audiences more effectively.
AirMap powers low-altitude drone navigation. Built by experts in GIS, aviation, and policy, AirMap provides reliable, real-time data and communication tools for safe drone operations below 500 feet.

Swish Analytics builds predictive data products for sports betting and fantasy. Rooted in engineering, math, and betting expertise — not intuition — Swish is redefining oddsmaking through next-generation analytics.

Hemster delivers the perfect fit from off-the-rack inventory. With the Perfect Fit Platform, retailers can tailor clothing to each shopper’s size, eliminating the frustration of searching for the right fit.

Starcity builds beautifully designed co-living communities in major cities. As a lifestyle brand, Starcity is on a mission to welcome thousands — and eventually millions — into a new way of urban living.
FanDuel is the premier gaming destination in the U.S. With a portfolio of innovative brands and products, FanDuel gives fans new ways to engage with their favorite sports, teams, and leagues.

Flick Sports connects fans with the sports communities they love. Designed for deeper engagement, Flick helps influencers, teams, and leagues grow and retain loyal fanbases — and speak to them directly.

Gameflip is a trusted marketplace for gamers. With over 5 million members, Gameflip lets users buy and sell games, gift cards, digital items, and even hire skilled teammates — all in one secure platform.

Jackpocket makes playing the lottery easier and more secure. As the first licensed third-party lottery app in the U.S., Jackpocket lets users order official state tickets from their phones while helping states generate funding for vital programs.

Life360 helps families stay safe and connected. With real-time location sharing, alerts, and safety features, Life360 gives families peace of mind — whether tracking teens, elderly drivers, or everyday routines.

Splitwise simplifies shared expenses. From rent to trips to meals, Splitwise keeps track of IOUs and group spending in one place — so everyone always knows who owes what.
Wheels offers sleek, safe electric mobility for the last mile. Designed for urban travel, Wheels delivers a fun, low-cost, and dockless ride experience — all powered through your smartphone.

Jump Ramp delivers rewards through mobile gaming. As a leader in promotional and instant win experiences, Jump Ramp connects consumers to top partners in gaming, commerce, and product discovery.
